presets.section_speed_hint: Affect the whole gameplay experience — taming, harvesting, breeding, drains. Vanilla = no changes.
presets.section_mode_hint: Complete recipes based on the kind of session you're going to play.
presets.section_focal_hint: Specific patches. Apply them on top of a macro to tweak just one area.
presets.vanilla.description: ARK's default configuration. Everything exactly as Wildcard ships it.
presets.casual_x2.description: Gentle improvements for limited playtime: 2x XP, taming, harvesting and breeding. Drains halved. Good middle ground.
presets.boosted_x5.description: Typical boosted server: 5x on everything important, short nights, fast breeding and max difficulty.
presets.hyper_x10.description: For heavily boosted servers or special events. 10x on almost everything, breeding x15-20, cuddle interval minimal.
presets.hardcore.description: Slower breeding, demanding drains, tougher dinos. For players seeking real challenge.
presets.single_player.description: Tuned for offline solo play: taming 10x, breeding 10x, low drains, decay off, up to 500 personal dinos.
presets.pve_server.description: For PvE community clusters. Moderate boosts with emphasis on comfortable breeding and protected structures.
presets.pvp_server.description: For active PvP servers: fast breeding to reach meta, moderate gathering, offline raid protection enabled.
presets.focal_breeding.description: Only modifies breeding/imprint. Hatch x20, frequent cuddles, imprint x10. Apply on top of any macro.
presets.focal_no_grind.description: Only reduces hunger/thirst/stamina to minimum. Leaves the rest of your config intact.
presets.focal_build_mode.description: For megabase building: gathering x10, indestructible structures, no decay, up to 30k structures per zone.
presets.section_quality_hint: Recommended graphics settings based on your PC. Only affect your client, not the server.
presets.quality_low.description: For modest PCs or laptops. Turns off most effects and lowers LOD. Prioritizes FPS.
presets.quality_medium.description: Middle ground: decent AO and materials, no big splurges. Solid framerate.
presets.quality_high.description: Most things on. The most popular choice for standard gaming PCs.
presets.quality_ultra.description: Everything on, LOD maxed, extra streaming. For modern cards.
presets.quality_epic.description: Maximum possible quality. Only for top-tier hardware with 12+ GB VRAM.

general.xp_multiplier.description: How much experience players and dinos earn per action. x2 = double XP. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.server_pve.description: When True, players can't damage each other or destroy other tribes' structures: the server becomes pure PvE. Default False (PvP enabled).
general.server_hardcore.description: When True, dying reverts your character to level 1. Every death wipes level progress. Default False.
general.allow_third_person.description: When False, blocks the third-person camera and forces first-person play. Default True (players can toggle).
general.server_crosshair.description: When False, hides the aiming crosshair for everyone: ranged aiming gets a lot harder. Default True.
general.server_force_no_hud.description: When True, always hides the floating name/level HUD over creatures that aren't your tribe's. Default False.
general.global_voice_chat.description: When True, voice chat is heard server-wide instead of only nearby. Default False.
general.proximity_chat.description: When True, chat messages are only visible to nearby players instead of the whole server. Default False.
general.always_notify_player_left.description: When True, everyone sees a notice when a player leaves the server. Default False.
general.dont_always_notify_player_joined.descrip: When True, disables the global player-joined notice. Default False (notices shown).
general.admin_logging.description: When True, every admin command is logged to in-game chat for everyone to see. Useful for transparency with multiple admins. Default False.
general.allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs: Hide damage source in tribe logs
general.allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs.descr: When False, tribe logs show what caused each hit (who or what attacked you). Default True (source hidden).
general.enable_pvp_gamma.description: When True, enables the gamma console command on PvP servers: night gets far more visible. Default False.
general.disable_pve_gamma.description: When True, blocks the gamma console command on PvE servers. Default False (allowed in PvE).
general.no_tribute_downloads.description: When True, blocks all cross-server data downloads (Cross-ARK transfers via obelisk or terminal). Default False.
general.prevent_download_survivors.description: When True, prevents downloading characters from ARK Data (cross-server transfers). Default False.
general.prevent_download_items.description: When True, prevents downloading items from ARK Data (cross-server transfers). Default False.
general.prevent_download_dinos.description: When True, prevents downloading creatures from ARK Data (cross-server transfers). Default False.
general.prevent_tribe_alliances.description: When True, tribes can't form alliances. Default False.
general.prevent_offline_pvp_interval.description: Seconds before offline raid protection (ORP) kicks in after the tribe disconnects. Official PvE servers use 10. Requires ORP enabled. Default 0.
general.rcon_port.description: TCP port for remote administration via RCON. Dedicated servers only; open it in your firewall if used. Default 27020.
general.listen_server_tether_distance.descriptio: Multiplies how far other players can move away from the host in non-dedicated sessions. x3 = three times the distance; 99 makes it nearly unlimited (heavier load on the host). Non-dedicated sessions only. Default 1.0.
general.harvest_amount.description: How many resources are gathered from a node. x3 = three times more wood, stone, etc. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.difficulty_offset.description: What percentage of wild dinos spawn at the highest possible levels. 1.0 = all at max level (recommended with OverrideOfficialDifficulty). Default 0.2 (official).
general.override_official_difficulty.description: Sets the maximum wild dino level (max level = value × 30). x5 = level 150, x10 = level 300. Default 5.0 (vanilla official).
general.show_map_player_location.description: Shows all players' positions on the in-game map. Useful for PvE or community servers. Default: disabled.
general.allow_flyer_carry_pve.description: Allows flying dinos to pick up players on PvE servers. Default: disabled.
general.fishing_loot_quality.description: Increases the quality of items obtained while fishing. Minimum 1.0 (lower not allowed). Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.global_spoiling_time.description: How fast food spoils in inventory and fridges. 0.5 = food lasts twice as long. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.global_item_decomposition_time.descripti: How long loot bags last after a dino or player dies. 5.0 = bags last 5× longer. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.weapon_damage.description: How much damage weapons deal (knives, bows, firearms). x2 kills dinos and players twice as fast; lowering it stretches fights out and makes armour matter more. Does not affect dino damage. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.hidden_engrams.description: List of engrams you want to hide from players (they won't be able to learn them). Useful for themed servers (primitive only, no tek, etc.).
general.kill_xp.description: Multiplies only the XP earned from killing creatures. Lets you tune leveling pace without touching global XP. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.harvest_xp.description: Multiplies only the XP from harvesting resources. Useful to reward gatherers more. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.craft_xp.description: Multiplies only the XP gained from crafting. Raising it rewards the player who crafts for the tribe, which otherwise is one of the poorest XP sources. At 0 crafting gives no XP at all. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.generic_xp.description: Multiplies XP from sources outside the other categories (events, internal quests). It's the catch-all: if you raised everything else and something still gives little XP, it probably falls here. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.special_xp.description: Multiplies XP from special in-game events. Raising it makes events pay far better than normal play; at 0 they stop giving XP. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.explorer_note_xp.description: Multiplies XP from Explorer Notes. It's one of the few multipliers that rewards exploring rather than killing or farming, so raising it noticeably changes the pace of a roleplay or adventure server. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.boss_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing bosses (Broodmother, Megapithecus, etc.). Raising it turns every boss into a big level jump, which fits if your server treats bosses as endgame content. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.alpha_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing Alpha dinos. Raising it rewards hunting them instead of avoiding them, which is what tends to happen when they pay the same as a regular dino. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.wild_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing regular wild dinos (neither Alpha nor boss). It's the most common XP source early on, so raising it mostly speeds up the first levels. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.cave_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing cave creatures. Raising it offsets the risk of going into caves, where dying and losing everything is easy. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.tamed_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing tamed dinos, meaning other tribes'. Raising it rewards PvP; at 0 killing someone else's dinos pays nothing. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.unclaimed_kill_xp.description: Multiplies XP for killing unclaimed dinos. Lowering it or setting it to 0 closes the trick of taming and releasing dinos purely to farm XP off them. ASA only. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.supply_crate_loot_quality.description: Raises the quality of loot from beacons on the map. Minimum 1.0. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
general.auto_save_period_minutes.description: How often (in minutes) the server saves the world. Lowering reduces loss but causes more save lag. Default 15.
general.rcon_server_game_log_buffer.description: How many log lines RCON keeps in memory for `getgamelog`. Raise if you need more history. Default 600.

taming.taming_speed.description: How fast the taming process completes. x5 = five times faster. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
taming.allow_speed_leveling.description: When True, points can again be spent on Movement Speed, which ASA disabled by default. Flyers additionally need bAllowFlyerSpeedLeveling. Default False.
taming.dino_count.description: Multiplier for how many wild dinos spawn on the map. High values can reduce server performance. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
taming.dino_damage.description: How much damage wild dinos deal. 0.5 = easier to fight, 2.0 = very dangerous. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
taming.dino_resistance.description: How much damage wild dinos absorb. Lower value = easier to kill. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
taming.max_tamed_dinos.description: Global cap for tamed dinos across the server. Lower it to help performance; raise it for more populated servers. Default 5000.
taming.allow_flyer_speed_leveling.description: Lets you spend level points on movement speed for tamed flying dinos. Default: disabled (Wildcard locked it).
taming.allow_unlimited_respecs.description: Lets you use mindwipe tonics multiple times without the 24h cooldown. Default: disabled (vanilla).
taming.max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit.descript: Threshold above which unused dinos start a countdown to deletion. ASA only. Default 5000.
taming.max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit_countdow: How many seconds dinos over the soft limit live before being deleted. 604800 = 7 days. ASA only.

breeding.egg_hatch_speed.description: Multiplier of the time eggs take to hatch. Higher = faster. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_mature_speed.description: Multiplier of how fast babies grow. Higher = faster. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_cuddle_interval.description: How often the baby asks for cuddles during raising. Lower = more frequent cuddles = easier to perfect imprint. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.mating_interval.description: Wait time between one mating and the next. Lower = can mate more often. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.lay_egg_interval.description: How often dinos lay unfertilized eggs. Lower = lay eggs more often. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_imprint_amount.description: How much imprint the baby gains per cuddle interaction. x2 = double imprint per cuddle. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_imprinting_stat_scale.description: How much the adult dino's stats improve from 100% imprint. x2 = double bonus from perfect imprint. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_cuddle_grace_period.description: How long the player has to respond to a cuddle request before losing imprint quality. Higher = more reaction time. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_food_consumption_speed.description: How fast babies empty their food inventory. 0.5 = eat at half speed. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.baby_cuddle_lose_imprint_quality_speed.d: How fast imprint quality drops when you don't tend to the baby on time. 0 = never lose imprint. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
breeding.allow_anyone_baby_imprint_cuddle.descrip: Any player can cuddle any baby (not just the original imprinter). Useful in collaborative tribes. Default: disabled.
breeding.disable_imprint_dino_buff.description: Removes the stat buff that imprint gives when the baby grows up. Default: disabled (imprint gives bonus).

stats.per_level_player.description: How much each player stat increases per level gained, relative to ARK's default. Each index is a different stat.
stats.oxygen_swim_speed_stat.description: How much each point spent in Oxygen speeds up swimming. Reduced by 80% in patch 256. Default 1.0.
stats.per_level_dino_tamed.description: How much each tamed dino stat increases per level gained. Index 0 = Health, 8 = Melee Damage.
stats.per_level_dino_wild.description: How much each wild dino stat increases per level. Affects all dinos before taming. Change with care.

players.player_damage.description: How much damage players deal to dinos and structures. x2 = double damage. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.player_health_recovery.description: How fast you regain health. x3 = you heal three times faster; 0.5 = half. Default 1.0.
players.prevent_diseases.description: When True, completely disables diseases on the server (currently, Swamp Fever). Default False.
players.non_permanent_diseases.description: When True, permanent diseases are lost on respawn instead of sticking forever. Default False.
players.implant_suicide_cd.description: Seconds a player must wait between two uses of the implant's Respawn feature. Default 28800 (8 hours).
players.player_resistance.description: How much damage players absorb. Lower value = players are more resistant to damage. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.player_water_drain.description: How fast the water bar depletes. 0.1 = player is almost never thirsty. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.player_food_drain.description: How fast the food bar depletes. 0.1 = player is almost never hungry. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.player_stamina_drain.description: How fast stamina is consumed while running, climbing, etc. 0.5 = stamina lasts twice as long. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.max_personal_tamed_dinos.description: Cap of tamed dinos per tribe. 0 = no per-tribe limit (only the server-wide cap applies). Default 0.
players.prevent_offline_pvp.description: On PvP, offline players take no damage until they log back in. Default: disabled.
players.allow_hit_markers.description: Shows a visual marker when landing hits on dinos or players. Default: enabled.
players.player_harvesting_damage.description: How much each player swing yields when harvesting nodes. x2 = double resources per hit. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.custom_recipe_effectiveness.description: How much player-made cooking-pot recipes yield. Raising it makes a homemade recipe beat vanilla food; lowering it makes them pointless. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.custom_recipe_skill.description: How much the player's Crafting Skill weighs in their recipe quality. Raising it makes a dedicated tribe cook worth having; lowering it levels everyone regardless of their points. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.crafting_skill_bonus.description: How much Crafting Skill boosts crafted item quality. x3 = much better items at the same skill. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
players.tribe_name_change_cooldown.description: How many minutes to wait between tribe name changes. 0 = no cooldown. Default 15.
players.kick_idle_players_period.description: How many seconds players can stay idle before being disconnected. 0 = don't kick. Default 3600 (1h).

world.resources_respawn.description: How fast resource nodes (trees, stone, etc.) respawn after being harvested. Lower value = faster respawn. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.day_cycle_speed_scale.description: Scales the passage of world time as a whole: x2 = the full cycle runs twice as fast, days last half as long. Different from DayTime/NightTimeSpeedScale, which adjust each half separately. Default 1.0.
world.random_supply_crate_points.description: When True, supply drops land at random locations instead of the fixed points. Warning: on Ragnarok this can make artifacts inaccessible. Default False.
world.harvest_health.description: How many hits a resource node can take before being depleted. x3 = must hit 3× more to harvest. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.day_time_speed.description: How fast time passes during the day. 0.5 = days twice as long, 2.0 = shorter days. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.night_time_speed.description: How fast time passes during the night. 5.0 = very short nights (recommended for PvE servers). Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.crop_growth.description: How fast plants grow in crop plots. x2 = twice as fast. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.disable_weather_fog.description: Removes the fog visual effect during weather events. Useful to improve visibility and performance. Default: disabled.
world.allow_cave_building_pve.description: Lets players build structures inside caves on PvE servers. Default: disabled.
world.enable_extra_structure_prevention_volume: Activates additional volumes where building is forbidden (obelisk areas, caves, etc.). Default: disabled.
world.force_all_structure_locking.description: All structures (doors, containers) start locked by default. Default: disabled.
world.poop_interval.description: How often dinos poop (used for fertilizer). Lower value = more fertilizer. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.crop_decay_speed.description: How fast crops wither without water/fertilizer. 0 = never wither. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.fuel_consumption_interval.description: How often structures (forge, cooker, generator) consume fuel. Higher value = fuel lasts longer. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.global_corpse_decomposition_time.descrip: How long dino or player corpses take to disappear. Higher value = last longer. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
world.item_stack_size.description: How many items fit per inventory slot. x10 = stacks of 100 wood, etc. Default 1.0 (vanilla).

structures.structure_damage.description: How much damage player structures take from external sources. 0 = indestructible structures (ideal for PvE). Default 1.0 (vanilla).
structures.the_max_structures_in_range.description: Maximum number of structures buildable within a fixed map area. Raising it allows megabases but can cost performance. Replaces the old NewMaxStructuresInRange. Default 10500.
structures.per_platform_max_structures.description: Multiplies the max number of pieces buildable on platform saddles and rafts. x2 = twice the pieces. Default 1.0.
structures.platform_saddle_build_area_bounds.descri: Multiplies how far from the platform's edge structures can be placed. Raising it allows builds that overhang further. Default 1.0.
structures.override_structure_platform_prevention.d: When True, turrets (and spikes) become buildable and functional on platform saddles. Changes the raiding meta a lot. Default False.
structures.disable_structure_decay_pve.description: When True, structures no longer auto-decay from inactivity in PvE. Careful on public servers: abandoned bases never disappear. Default False.
structures.pve_structure_decay_period.description: Multiplies structure auto-decay timers: x2 = they take twice as long to decay, 0.5 = half. Default 1.0.
structures.pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.des: When True, allows building near supply drop points in PvE mode. Default False.
structures.structure_prevent_resource_radius.descri: Multiplies the radius around structures where resources won't respawn. Lowering it lets trees and rocks regrow closer to your base. Same as Game.ini's ResourceNoReplenishRadiusStructures; if both are set, they multiply. Default 1.0.
structures.allow_integrated_splus_structures.descri: When False, disables the Homestead update's integrated structures (the official S+ port), meant for servers that still run the S+ mod and don't want duplicates. Default True.
structures.structure_resistance.description: Resistance factor of structures. Lower value = tougher structures. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
structures.max_structures.description: Maximum number of tribe structures within a given radius. Increasing allows larger bases but may reduce performance. Default 6000.
structures.enable_decay_pvp.description: Activates the structure decay system on PvP servers. Default: disabled.
structures.pvp_structure_decay.description: Applies PvE decay rules to PvP as well. Useful for cleaning up abandoned bases. Default: disabled.
structures.only_decay_unsnapped_core.description: Only foundation structures not snapped to another base will decay. Useful against pillar spam. Default: disabled.
structures.always_allow_structure_pickup.descriptio: Structures can always be picked up regardless of when they were placed. Default: disabled.
structures.structure_pickup_time_after_placement.de: How many seconds you can pick up a structure after placing it. 0 = never. Default 30s.
structures.structure_pickup_hold_duration.descripti: How long to hold the button to pick up a structure. Raising it prevents picking things up by accident; at 0 a single tap does it, which is convenient while building but risky inside your base. Default 0.5s.
structures.limit_bunkers_per_tribe.description: Enables the cap on bunkers each tribe can build. ASA only. Default: enabled.
structures.limit_bunkers_per_tribe_num.description: How many bunkers a tribe can have active at once. Lowering it forces a choice of where to fortify; raising it lets a big tribe cover half the map. ASA only. Default 3.
structures.allow_riding_dinos_inside_bunkers.descri: Players can ride dinos inside the bunker area. ASA only. Default: enabled.
structures.allow_dino_ai_inside_bunkers.description: NPC dinos can move and attack inside the bunker. ASA only. Default: enabled.
structures.min_distance_between_bunkers.description: How far apart bunkers must be, in game units (3000 is roughly 10 foundations). Raising it spreads them across the map; lowering it lets them cluster in one area. ASA only. Default 3000.
structures.enemy_access_bunker_hp_threshold.descrip: Bunker HP percentage below which enemies can enter. 0.25 = 25%. ASA only.
structures.bunker_under_hp_threshold_dmg_multiplier: How much extra damage a bunker takes below the threshold. Low = bunker lasts much longer. ASA only. Default 0.05.
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_regen_hp: Hours to regen HP in cryo (ASA)
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_regen_hp.descript: How many hours a cryoed dino takes to fully regen health. Lowering it turns cryo into a near-instant heal after a raid; raising it forces healing by hand. ASA only. Default 1h.
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_regen_food: Hours to regen food in cryo (ASA)
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_regen_food.descri: How many hours it takes to fill a cryoed dino's food. Lowering it saves having to feed it before taking it out to fight. ASA only. Default 24h.
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_drain_torpor: Hours to drain torpor in cryo (ASA)
structures.cryo_hospital_hours_to_drain_torpor.desc: How many hours it takes to drain a cryoed dino's torpor. Lowering it lets you reuse a knocked-out dino right away; raising it keeps it out of action longer. ASA only. Default 1h.
How much faster the mating cooldown drains while a dino is cryoed. Raising it speeds up a breeding line a lot, since you can store the parents instead of having them take up pen space. ASA only. Default 2.
structures.bloodforge_reinforce_extra_durability.de: Extra durability (percent) from reinforcing an item in the Bloodforge. ASA only. Default 0.3.
structures.bloodforge_reinforce_resource_cost_multi: Resource cost multiplier when reinforcing items. ASA only. Default 3.
structures.bloodforge_reinforce_speed_multiplier.de: How fast the Bloodforge processes. Higher = faster. ASA only. Default 0.1.
structures.max_active_outposts.description: How many outposts can be active at the same time on the server. ASA only. Default 6.
structures.max_active_resource_caches.description: How many resource caches can be active at the same time. ASA only. Default 6.
structures.max_active_city_outposts.description: How many city outposts can be active at the same time. ASA only. Default 6.
structures.max_active_outposts_sp.description: How many outposts active in single player or host local. ASA only. Default 1.
structures.max_active_resource_caches_sp.descriptio: How many resource caches active in single player or host local. ASA only. Default 6.
structures.max_active_city_outposts_sp.description: How many city outposts active in single player or host local. ASA only. Default 1.

spawns.dino_spawn_weight.description: Raises or lowers the chance of each species spawning. Setting SpawnWeightMultiplier to 0 removes the species from the map entirely.
spawns.npc_replacements.description: Replaces a dino with another on the map (e.g., Rex with Indominus). If ToClassName is empty, that dino stops spawning.

resources.harvest_resource_class.description: Changes how many resources a specific node yields (e.g., x10 metal but x1 wood). Allows fine adjustments impossible with the global multiplier.

dinos.dino_class_damage.description: Multiplies the damage of a specific wild species (e.g., nerf Alpha Rex without touching others). Multiplier 1.0 = no change.
dinos.disable_dino_decay_pve.description: When True, dinos no longer decay from inactivity in PvE (they don't become claimable). Default False.
dinos.pve_dino_decay_period.description: Multiplies dino auto-decay time in PvE: x2 = twice as long. Requires DisableDinoDecayPvE set to False. Default 1.0.
dinos.pvp_dino_decay.description: When True, dinos decay while offline raid protection (ORP) is active. Default False.
dinos.allow_raid_dino_feeding.description: When True, Titanosaurs can be fed and stay permanently tamed. The Island spawns at most 3, so 3 tamed ones block new spawns. Default False.
dinos.dino_food_drain.description: How fast creatures get hungry. x2 = they eat twice as fast, and food-based taming speeds up; 0.5 = half. Default 1.0.
dinos.dino_stamina_drain.description: How fast creatures burn stamina. 0.5 = they tire half as fast and flyers travel twice as far; x2 = they tire twice as fast. Default 1.0.
dinos.dino_health_recovery.description: How fast creatures regain health. x3 = they heal three times faster. Default 1.0.
dinos.force_gacha_unhappy_in_caves.description: When True, Gachas become unhappy inside caves and stop producing. Default True.
dinos.dino_class_resistance.description: Multiplies the resistance of a specific wild species. Lower multiplier = easier to kill.
dinos.tamed_dino_class_damage.description: Multiplies the damage of a specific tamed species. Useful to nerf/buff individual dinos without touching the global.
dinos.tamed_dino_class_resistance.description: Multiplies the resistance of a specific tamed species. Lets you balance dino by dino.
dinos.dino_harvesting_damage.description: How much a dino's attack yields when harvesting (e.g., Anky striking metal). Default 3.2 (vanilla).
dinos.dino_turret_damage.description: How much damage automatic turrets deal to dinos. x2 = double damage. Default 1.0 (vanilla).
dinos.raid_dino_food_drain.description: How fast Titanos, Forest Titan, Mek and other raid dinos eat. Lower = last longer. Default 1.0 (vanilla).

client.graphics_quality.description: Global quality preset. 0 = Low, 4 = Epic. ARK adjusts several effects when changed. Default 4.
client.true_sky_quality.description: Detail of clouds and atmosphere. 0 = basic, 3 = high quality. Affects performance. Default 3.
client.ground_clutter_density.description: How much vegetation is rendered on the ground. 0 = minimal (more FPS), 1 = everything. Default 1.
client.lod_scalar.description: Multiplier for detail of distant objects. 0.5 = lower quality but more FPS, 1.5 = sharpest. Default 1.0.
client.use_distance_field_ao.description: Realistic occlusion shading using distance fields. GPU-heavy. Default: enabled.
client.use_ssao.description: Screen-space ambient occlusion. Adds depth to shadows. Default: enabled.
client.motion_blur.description: Camera-motion blur effect. Many prefer it off. Default: enabled.
client.film_grain.description: Cinematic grain effect over the image. Turning it off leaves a cleaner, sharper picture and is one of the first things most people disable. Barely affects performance. Default: enabled.
client.distance_field_shadowing.description: High-quality shadows for distant objects. Turning it off gains FPS in open areas with heavy foliage, at the cost of a flatter-looking distance. Default: enabled.
client.high_quality_materials.description: Detailed textures and shaders. VRAM-heavy. Default: enabled.
client.high_quality_surfaces.description: Greater detail on floors and walls. Default: enabled.
client.high_quality_anisotropic_filtering.descr: Sharper textures viewed at an angle. Low cost on modern GPUs. Default: enabled.
client.high_quality_lods.description: More detailed distant models. Turning it off gains FPS and makes pop-in more noticeable as objects swap detail level when you approach. Default: enabled.
client.low_quality_level_streaming.description: Loads parts of the world with less detail to boost FPS. Default: disabled.
client.extra_level_streaming_distance.descripti: Loads the world farther ahead. Reduces pop-in but uses more memory. Default: disabled.
client.enable_color_grading.description: Applies ARK's cinematic colour tuning. Turning it off gives a more neutral image and usually makes dark areas easier to read, which is an advantage in PvP. Near-zero performance cost. Default: enabled.
client.disable_bloom.description: Removes the glow from bright sources. Default: disabled (bloom on).
client.disable_light_shafts.description: Removes volumetric light rays. Default: disabled (rays on).
client.allow_animation_staggering.description: Distributes creature animations to improve FPS with many dinos on screen. Default: enabled.
client.low_quality_animations.description: Reduces bone quality on distant animations. Default: disabled.
client.low_quality_vfx.description: Reduces particles and VFX. Default: disabled.
client.use_vsync.description: Syncs FPS to monitor refresh rate. Reduces tearing but may add input lag. Default: disabled.
client.fov_multiplier.description: Changes the FOV. Higher = more peripheral vision. Default 1.0.
client.ui_scaling.description: Global size of UI elements. Default 1.0.
client.client_net_quality.description: How much info the client receives from the server. 0 = minimum, 3 = maximum. Default 3.
client.active_lingering_world_tiles.description: Number of map zones kept loaded in memory. More = less pop-in but more RAM. Default 7.
client.enable_dlss.description: ASA only. -1 = automatic (per GPU), 0 = off, 1 = on. Requires an NVIDIA RTX GPU. Default -1.
client.enable_dlfg.description: ASA only. Generates extra frames with AI to nearly double FPS. Requires RTX 40-series or newer. Default: disabled.
client.frame_multiplier.description: ASA only. Number of generated frames (1 = no generation, 2 = double, 4 = quadruple on newer GPUs). Default 2.
client.enable_reflex.description: ASA only. Reduces input lag on supported NVIDIA GPUs. Recommended for PvP. Default: disabled.
client.super_resolution_quality_level.descripti: ASA only. Quality level of the super resolution upscaler (DLSS/FSR/XeSS). 0 = Ultra Performance, 4 = Quality. Default 0.
client.use_dynamic_resolution.description: ASA only. Adjusts internal resolution in real time to keep FPS stable. Default: disabled.
client.screen_percentage.description: ASA only. Percentage of native resolution to render at. 0.5 = 50% (more FPS), 2.0 = 200% (super sampling). Default 1.0.
client.frame_rate_limit.description: ASA only. Cap on frames per second (0 = unlimited). Useful to reduce power draw and temperature. Default 0.
client.enable_hdr_output.description: ASA only. Enables HDR output if your monitor supports it. Default: disabled.
client.hdr_display_min_luminance.description: ASA only. HDR black point on a log2 scale. Typical value: -4. Raising it brightens shadows. Default -4.
client.hdr_display_mid_luminance.description: ASA only. HDR mid point in cd/m². Typical value: 20. Default 20.
client.hdr_display_max_luminance.description: ASA only. HDR monitor peak brightness in nits. Check your monitor specs (typical 1000–4000). Default 1000.
client.frame_generation_method.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. 0 = none, 1 = DLSS-FG (NVIDIA), 2 = FSR-FG (AMD). Default 0.
client.frame_generation_multiplier.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. Frame-generation multiplier applied at game launch. Default 2.
client.super_resolution_system.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. 0 = none, 1 = DLSS, 2 = FSR, 3 = XeSS, 4 = TSR (Unreal). Default 0.
client.fsr_quality_mode.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. 0 = Quality, 1 = Balanced, 2 = Performance, 3 = Ultra Performance, 4 = Native AA. Default 0.
client.dlss_quality_mode.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. 0 = Quality, 1 = Balanced, 2 = Performance, 3 = Ultra Performance, 4 = DLAA. Default 0.
client.reflex_enabled.description: ASA only, [Startup] section. -1 = system default, 0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = on + boost. Default -1.

resource_gatherers.global_production_multiplier.description: How much all gatherers' production multiplies. x5 = five times more. Default 1.0.

improved_egg_incubator.prevent_egg_filtering_on_pickup.descript: Prevents eggs from being filtered when picked up off the ground. Default: enabled.

improved_egg_incubator.bonus_gestation.description: Applies bonus to viviparous dinos in the incubator. Default: enabled.

improved_egg_incubator.gestation_speed.description: Speed multiplier for gestation inside the incubator. Default 1.

dino_storage_v2.baby_growth_multiplier.description: Babies keep growing inside the soul at this rate. 0 = frozen; 1 = same as the world rate.
dino_storage_v2.baby_instant_growth: Babies release as adults with 100% imprint
dino_storage_v2.baby_instant_growth.description: On release they become adults with full imprint. A big shortcut: it skips raising entirely.
dino_storage_v2.remove_mating_cooldown.description: Storing and releasing a female wipes her mating cooldown. Speeds up mass breeding a lot.
dino_storage_v2.keep_cuddle_type.description: The baby keeps which cuddle and food it was asking for instead of rerolling on release.
dino_storage_v2.incubation_multiplier.description: Multiplies the server rate for incubating fertilised eggs inside the terminal.
dino_storage_v2.enable_incubation.description: Lets the terminal incubate the fertilised eggs stored inside it.
dino_storage_v2.enable_fert_egg_collection.description: The terminal automatically picks up fertilised eggs laid by nearby dinos.
dino_storage_v2.passive_hp.description: Multiplies the health the dino recovers while inside the soul.
dino_storage_v2.passive_stam.description: Multiplies the stamina the dino recovers while stored.
dino_storage_v2.passive_food.description: Multiplies the food the stored dino regenerates. At 0 it does not eat, which is the default.
dino_storage_v2.passive_xp.description: Multiplies the experience the dino accrues while inside the soul.
dino_storage_v2.passive_charge.description: Multiplies charge recovery for light pets (Shinehorn, Bulbdog, Featherlight) while stored.
dino_storage_v2.passive_wool.description: Multiplies sheep wool growth while inside the soul.
dino_storage_v2.torp_recovery.description: Multiplies how fast torpor drains while the dino is stored.
dino_storage_v2.use_cryo_sickness.description: Released dinos come out sick, like vanilla cryopods. Off by default — it is the main reason people use this mod.
dino_storage_v2.use_cryo_nerf.description: Mirrors the official cryopod restrictions instead of the mod's own rules.
dino_storage_v2.soul_sickness_duration.description: How many minutes the dino stays sick after release. Only applies when sickness is enabled.
dino_storage_v2.soul_sickness_damage.description: How much extra damage a dino takes while sick from being released.
dino_storage_v2.sickness_ignore_baby.description: Exempts babies from the sickness debuff on release.
dino_storage_v2.sickness_prevents_release.description: Instead of applying the debuff, it blocks release outright while the cooldown lasts.
dino_storage_v2.death_auto_trap: Auto-trap the dino right before death
dino_storage_v2.death_auto_trap.description: Traps the dino automatically a moment before it dies. A safety net for valuable dinos.
dino_storage_v2.datgive_to_player: Send the soul to the nearest player
dino_storage_v2.datgive_to_player.description: With death auto-trap on, it tries to put the soul in the nearest player's inventory.
dino_storage_v2.datgive_to_terminal: Send the soul to the nearest terminal
dino_storage_v2.datgive_to_terminal.description: With death auto-trap on, it tries to deposit the soul in the nearest terminal.
dino_storage_v2.datprevent_drop: Never drop the soul on the ground
dino_storage_v2.datprevent_drop.description: If there is no player or terminal to receive it, the soul is not dropped (and the dino is lost).
dino_storage_v2.datrequire_trapper: Require an empty soul trap at the destination
dino_storage_v2.datrequire_trapper.description: Death auto-trap only works if an empty soul trap is available where it would be stored.
dino_storage_v2.enable_all_generation.description: Turns on every automated generation in the terminal at once (eggs, poop, honey, wool, and so on).
dino_storage_v2.enable_poop_conversion.description: Stored dung beetles turn poop into fertiliser inside the terminal.
dino_storage_v2.enable_egg_generation.description: Stored dinos produce regular eggs inside the terminal.
dino_storage_v2.poop_convert_speed.description: Multiplies how fast the dung beetle turns poop into fertiliser.
dino_storage_v2.terminal_check_interval.description: How often the terminal runs its generation and incubation pass. Very low values load the server.
dino_storage_v2.terminal_needs_power.description: The terminal only automates while inside the radius of a powered tek generator.
dino_storage_v2.can_trap_corpse.description: Lets you store dead dinos to revive them later. Changes how costly losing a dino is.
dino_storage_v2.corpse_removes_imprint.description: The revived dino loses its imprint percentage. A common cost to balance revival.
dino_storage_v2.corpse_resets_level.description: The revived dino loses every level the player added and returns to its tamed level.
dino_storage_v2.revival_health.description: Health percentage a dino revived from its corpse comes back with.
dino_storage_v2.no_combat_trap.description: Prevents trapping while combat music is playing. A common PvP anti-abuse rule.
dino_storage_v2.trap_health.description: Requires the dino to have at least this health percentage before it can be trapped. 0 = no requirement.
dino_storage_v2.require_ownership: Only the owner can trap or release
dino_storage_v2.require_ownership.description: Requires being the dino's owner to trap or release it, rather than just being in the tribe.
dino_storage_v2.release_consumes_trapper.description: The soul is destroyed on release, so a new one must be crafted every time.
dino_storage_v2.required_release_level.description: Minimum player level to unlock releasing dinos. 0 = no restriction.
dino_storage_v2.prevent_cave_release.description: Prevents releasing dinos in caves where building is disabled, keeping big dinos out of them.
dino_storage_v2.soul_trap_stack_size.description: How many empty soul traps fit in a single inventory slot.
dino_storage_v2.terminal_slots.description: Inventory slot count for the soul terminal. The mod caps this at 300.
dino_storage_v2.prevent_upload.description: Blocks uploading souls to obelisks or transferring them between servers.
dino_storage_v2.drop_costume.description: The costume drops on the ground instead of being stored with the dino.
dino_storage_v2.drop_equipment.description: Everything equipped drops on the ground instead of being stored.
dino_storage_v2.drop_helmet.description: The helmet drops on the ground instead of being stored.
dino_storage_v2.drop_saddle.description: The saddle drops on the ground instead of being stored.
dino_storage_v2.drop_weapon.description: The equipped weapon drops on the ground instead of being stored.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_amphibious.description: Prevents trapping and releasing amphibious dinos.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_big.description: Prevents trapping and releasing big dinos.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_corrupted.description: Prevents trapping and releasing corrupted dinos.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_flyer.description: Prevents trapping and releasing rideable flyers.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_raid.description: Prevents trapping and releasing raid dinos.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_water.description: Prevents trapping and releasing water dinos.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_enraged_giga.description: Prevents trapping a Giga while it is enraged.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_immobile.description: Prevents trapping dinos held by nets, traps or similar.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_torped.description: Prevents trapping knocked-out dinos, closing the tame-and-store shortcut.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_unclaimed.description: Prevents trapping dinos that have been left unclaimed.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_foreign_pure.description: Prevents releasing dinos that were trapped by another tribe.
dino_storage_v2.include_foreign.description: Allows releasing foreign dinos even when the server config forbids it.
dino_storage_v2.keep_ally_looking_status.description: The dino keeps the ally-looking toggle on release instead of resetting to default.
dino_storage_v2.keep_enabled_mating_status.description: The dino keeps the enable-mating toggle on release instead of resetting to default.
dino_storage_v2.keep_enabled_wander_status.description: The dino keeps the enable-wandering toggle on release instead of resetting to default.
dino_storage_v2.keep_force_tamed_status.description: The dino keeps the force-tamed status on release instead of resetting to default.
dino_storage_v2.keep_ignore_whistle_status.description: The dino keeps the ignore-whistle toggle on release instead of resetting to default.
dino_storage_v2.lock_imprinter.description: Prevents the imprint owner changing when another player releases the dino.
dino_storage_v2.release_use_defaults.description: The dino comes out with every toggle at the game default.
dino_storage_v2.release_ignore_type.description: Flips the exclusion rules and force-allows releasing any dino.
dino_storage_v2.remove_all_buffs.description: The dino comes out without any of the buffs it had when stored.
dino_storage_v2.remove_clone_tags.description: The released dino loses its cloned marker.
dino_storage_v2.remove_titan_load.description: Removes the mandatory wait when releasing a Titan.
dino_storage_v2.trap_tames_fish.description: Trapping certain fish tames them, like fish baskets do.
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_hp.description: Turns off health regen while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_stam.description: Turns off stamina recovery while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_xp.description: Turns off experience gain while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_charge: Disable light pet recharge while stored
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_charge.description: Turns off light pet recharge while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.remove_passive_wool.description: Turns off wool growth while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.remove_torp_recovery.description: Turns off torpor recovery while the dino is inside the soul, ignoring its multiplier.
dino_storage_v2.trap_tamed_time.description: Minutes to wait after taming before the dino can be trapped. 0 = no wait.
dino_storage_v2.trap_hurt_time.description: Minutes to wait after the dino takes damage. A PvP anti-abuse rule.
dino_storage_v2.trap_near_base.description: Requires being within this distance of friendly structures to trap. 0 = no requirement.
dino_storage_v2.trap_near_terminal.description: Requires being within this distance of a friendly terminal to trap. 0 = no requirement.
dino_storage_v2.platform_structure_grace.description: How many structures the saddle may carry and still allow trapping.
dino_storage_v2.trapping_tribe_logs: Log trapping to the tribe log
dino_storage_v2.trapping_tribe_logs.description: Every trapped dino adds an entry to the tribe log.
dino_storage_v2.release_near_base.description: Requires being within this distance of friendly structures to release. 0 = no requirement.
dino_storage_v2.release_near_terminal.description: Requires being within this distance of a friendly terminal to release. 0 = no requirement.
dino_storage_v2.release_prevent_dupe_id.description: Checks that no dino with the same ID already exists before releasing. Anti-duping.
dino_storage_v2.release_tribe_logs: Log releasing to the tribe log
dino_storage_v2.release_tribe_logs.description: Every released dino adds an entry to the tribe log.
dino_storage_v2.require_tribe_ranks.description: Requires permission to ride the dino in order to release it.
dino_storage_v2.keep_trapper_equipped.description: After releasing, the empty soul stays in hand instead of going to the inventory.
dino_storage_v2.loot_bag_life_span.description: Minutes the bag with whatever could not be stored lasts on the ground.
dino_storage_v2.ignore_spatial_check.description: Disables the has-room check before releasing. Can drop dinos inside structures.
dino_storage_v2.ignore_enemy_structures.description: Disables the nearby enemy structure check on release.

dino_storage_v2.exclude_class.description: Prevents trapping or releasing these dino classes. Matches if the path ends with what you write, or exactly if you append `_C`: writing `Rex_Character_BP` also blocks the Tek Rex, while `Rex_Character_BP_C` blocks only the regular one.

dino_storage_v2.exclude_source: Mods whose dinos cannot be stored
dino_storage_v2.exclude_source.description: Prevents trapping or releasing dinos by where they come from: matches the folder after `/Game/`, or after `/Mods/` when present. The way to block a whole mod's dinos at once.
dino_storage_v2.include_source.description: Force-allows dinos from these mods, overriding any exclusion. Matches the folder the same way as the exclude list.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_tag.description: Prevents trapping or releasing dinos whose name contains these tags. Searched as text inside the soul title, so it blocks by name rather than by classname.
dino_storage_v2.include_tag.description: Force-allows dinos whose name contains these tags, overriding any exclusion.
dino_storage_v2.convert_class.description: Turns one dino into another when it leaves the soul. Each entry is a `sourcePath:targetPath` pair and entries are comma-separated. Useful to replace dinos from a mod you removed with a vanilla equivalent instead of losing them.

dino_storage_v2.buffs_prevent_trapping.description: If the dino has any of these effects active it cannot be trapped. In PvP this is what stops dinos escaping a fight into a soul.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_buff_class.description: Prevents these buff classes from being re-applied to the dino when it leaves the soul.
dino_storage_v2.include_buff_class.description: Forces these buff classes onto the dino when it leaves the soul, overriding any exclusion.
dino_storage_v2.exclude_buff_source: Mods whose buffs are not restored
dino_storage_v2.exclude_buff_source.description: Like the previous one but by source: matches the folder of the mod the buff comes from.
dino_storage_v2.include_buff_source.description: Forces restoration of buffs coming from these mods.
dino_storage_v2.aaexclude_class: Dinos exempt from the Anti-Alpha check
dino_storage_v2.aaexclude_class.description: Removes these classes from the Anti-Alpha check. The author advises against it: alpha buffs boost nearby wild dinos even when tamed.

weapons_plus.mining_drill_harvest_multiplier.descript: Multiplies what the mining drill gathers. Mod default: 2.

weapons_plus.metal_sickle_harvest_multiplier.descript: Multiplies what the metal sickle gathers. Mod default: 2.
weapons_plus.weapons_bench_crafting_speed.description: Multiplies the crafting speed of the mod's bench. Mod default: 50.
weapons_plus.weapons_bench_max_inventry_slots.descrip: Inventory slot count for the bench. Mod default: 400.
weapons_plus.tek_no_struct_dmg: Tek weapons do not damage structures
weapons_plus.tek_no_struct_dmg.description: Stops the mod's tek weaponry from breaking buildings. Mod default: on.
weapons_plus.homing_missile_lock_on_distance.descript: Maximum distance at which the missile can lock a target. Mod default: 14000.
weapons_plus.apturret_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage of every auto turret. Mod default: 1.
weapons_plus.t2_turret_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage of every heavy turret. Mod default: 1.
weapons_plus.apturret_targeting_speed.description: How fast the turret rotates to track a target. Mod default: 140.
weapons_plus.apturret_fire_interval.description: Seconds between shots. Lower fires faster. Mod default: 0.2.
weapons_plus.t2_turret_targeting_speed.description: How fast the heavy turret rotates to track a target. Mod default: 140.
weapons_plus.tek_turret_targeting_speed.description: How fast the tek turret rotates to track a target. Mod default: 180.
weapons_plus.event_fab_pistol.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.
weapons_plus.event_fab_sniper.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.
weapons_plus.event_golden_gun.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.
weapons_plus.event_bolt_action.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.
weapons_plus.event_machined_rifle.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.
weapons_plus.event_shotgun.description: Damage for the event variant. Only applies while the mod's event is active. Mod default: 500.

b2k_binocular.prevent_enemy_stats.description: Blocks reading any stats off other tribes' dinos. The PvP setting: without it the binocular lets you scout an enemy base and pick which dino is worth stealing before attacking.
b2k_binocular.disable_radar_esp.description: Turns off the radar (reload key, 'R' by default) that marks nearby targets. The closest thing to a wallhack in the mod and the first thing PvP servers remove.
b2k_binocular.no_aim_targeting.description: The target's info appears just by looking at it, with no need to enter targeting mode. Convenient while taming, but removes the tell that someone is scoping you.
b2k_binocular.always_show_points_column.description: Keeps the per-stat points column pinned instead of toggling it with the attachment key ('N' by default). Very handy for breeding and checking mutations.
b2k_binocular.always_show_foods_column.description: Keeps the preferred-food column pinned instead of toggling it with the map key ('G' by default).
b2k_binocular.stats_delay.description: Seconds the dino's info stays on screen after you look away. 0 makes it vanish instantly. The author caps it at 10.
b2k_binocular.prevent_enemy_dino_points.description: A softer version of "Hide enemy dino stats": stats stay visible but the per-level point spread doesn't, so you can't judge the quality of someone else's breeding.
b2k_binocular.disable_dino_points.description: Removes the per-stat points column entirely, yours and everyone else's. Without it the binocular replaces any breeding calculator.
b2k_binocular.disable_dino_foods.description: Stops showing what the dino you're looking at eats. Forces knowing the taming table instead of reading it off the screen.
b2k_binocular.disable_night_vision.description: Turns off the binocular's night vision (melee/pistol whip, 'Left Ctrl' by default), which only works while targeting.
b2k_binocular.disable_trace_floating_hud.description: Keeps only dino stats and drops structure and player info at range. Useful if you want the binocular as a taming tool but not as a scouting tool.

boosted_fab.smithy_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the crafting speed of the mod's smithy. The author warns that pushing crafting speeds too high can break the server.
boosted_fab.fab_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the fabricator's speed, the mod's main station. The author warns that pushing speeds too high can break the server.
boosted_fab.auto_fab_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the auto-fabricator's speed. It ships lower than the regular one on purpose, since it crafts without you being there.
boosted_fab.chem_bench_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the speed of the mod's chemistry bench.
boosted_fab.forge_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the metal smelting speed of the mod's forge.
boosted_fab.explosive_fab_craft_speed.description: Multiplies how fast explosives are crafted. The only one that ships un-boosted (×1): in PvP, fast C4 crafting changes the pace of raids.
boosted_fab.grill_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the cooking speed of the mod's grill.
boosted_fab.cooker_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the cooking pot's speed, where kibble and dyes are made. It ships high because bulk cooking is one of the game's biggest time sinks.
boosted_fab.beer_craft_speed.description: Multiplies the beer barrel's speed. The highest default of them all, because vanilla beer takes an age.
boosted_fab.turret_base_damage.description: Per-shot damage of the mod's turret. It's the number that sets a base's defensive balance in PvP, so change it carefully.
boosted_fab.heavy_turret_base_damage.description: Per-shot damage of the heavy turret, which by default hits over 4× harder than the regular one.
boosted_fab.siege_shell_damage.description: Damage of the siege shell. The mod's heaviest weapon and what breaks structures during a raid.
boosted_fab.rifle_damage.description: Actual torpor is this number × 50, so the default of 10 means 500 torpor per shot. Lives in the [TranqGuns] section of the same file.
boosted_fab.sniper_damage.description: Actual torpor is this number × 50: the default of 7 means 350 per shot. Less torpor than the rifle but far longer range.
boosted_fab.missile_damage.description: Actual torpor is this number × 50: the default of 16 means 800 per shot. Half the damage is direct and half is AoE over 1.5s, plus a gas cloud.

ckf.disable_pickup.description: Removes the option to pick a placed part back up. In PvP it blocks the trick of dismantling and re-placing defences mid-raid.
ckf.disable_foundation_stacking.description: CKF foundations stack and step so you can build on uneven ground and bridge gaps. Turning it off makes them behave like vanilla ones — the usual choice on servers that don't want foundation towers.
ckf.disable_automatic_doors.description: CKF doors open and close on approach. Turning it off restores manual opening, which also stops a door from giving you away as you walk past.
ckf.structure_crafting_speed.description: Multiplies the speed of the masonry table and the mod's other stations. Only affects CKF structures, not vanilla ones.
ckf.pickup_when_damaged.description: By default a damaged part can't be picked up. Enabling it speeds up repairing a base after an attack, but also lets half-broken structures be dismantled.
ckf.disable_pickup_delay_timer.description: Removes the time window after placing during which a part can be picked back up. With this on, any part can always be picked up (unless pick-up is disabled outright).
ckf.ceiling_is_foundation.description: Ceilings provide structural support as if they were foundations, letting you build upwards without pillars. Belongs to CKF:R. Note it considerably increases what can be built in mid-air.
ckf.parts_are_foundation.description: CKF:Sci-Fi's equivalent of the previous setting, but broader: any part provides structural support. Only has an effect if the Sci-Fi mod is installed.
ckf.stacked_foundation_has_full_hp.descripti: By default a foundation stacked on another has reduced health, precisely to discourage foundation towers. Enabling this gives them full health back.
ckf.structure_cooking_speed.description: Multiplies the speed of the mod's cooking and smelting structures. Only affects CKF ones.
ckf.settler_is_stone.description: The Settler tier is wood-equivalent by default. This raises it to stone without changing how it looks.
ckf.settler_is_metal.description: Raises the Settler tier (wood by default) to metal resistance while keeping its rustic look.
ckf.settler_is_tek.description: Raises the Settler tier to tek resistance. The biggest jump of them all: a medieval-looking base that tanks like tek completely changes raid balance.
ckf.villager_is_wood.description: The Villager tier is stone-equivalent by default. This drops it to wood, for servers that don't want the pretty structures to also be the toughest.
ckf.villager_is_metal.description: Raises the Villager tier (stone by default) to metal resistance.
ckf.villager_is_tek.description: Raises the Villager tier to tek resistance.
ckf.keep_is_wood.description: The Castle tier — the top one, metal-equivalent — drops to wood. Useful on PvP servers where nothing should tank like metal.
ckf.keep_is_stone.description: Drops the Castle tier (metal by default) to stone resistance.
ckf.keep_is_tek.description: Raises the Castle tier to tek resistance, the highest in the game. Only high-tier explosives will break it.
ckf.composite_is_stone.description: Changes CKF:Sci-Fi's Composite tier resistance to stone. Only has an effect if the Sci-Fi mod is installed.
ckf.composite_is_tek.description: Raises CKF:Sci-Fi's Composite tier to tek resistance. Only has an effect if the Sci-Fi mod is installed.

ckf_legacy.is_primitive.description: With this on, Castle tier pieces take on stone's damage properties instead of metal's. It's the setting that lowers the mod's defensive ceiling: with it off, a CKF base tanks like metal.
ckf_legacy.ceiling_is_foundation.description: Ceilings register as foundations on placement, so you can build a long bridge without the "requires foundation support" error. Note the author's caveat: it applies at placement time, so turning it back off does NOT affect ceilings already placed — they keep counting as foundations until removed or decayed.
ckf_legacy.disable_auto_doors.description: Turns auto-open and auto-close off by default. It isn't final: each player can re-enable them door by door by long-holding E on it.
ckf_legacy.scaffold_tier.description: Which material sets the damage properties of scaffold parts. Raising it to stone or metal turns them into real defensive structures; at wood they are what the name says, temporary.
ckf_legacy.settler_tier.description: Which material sets the damage properties of the Settler tier, wood-equivalent out of the box. Raising it lets a rustic-looking base tank like stone or metal, which noticeably shifts raid balance.
ckf_legacy.villager_tier.description: Which material sets the damage properties of the Villager tier, stone-equivalent out of the box. Dropping it to wood is what servers do when the pretty structures shouldn't also be the toughest.
ckf_legacy.palisade.description: Which material sets the damage properties of palisades. The author includes it in the example block with the value `stone` but never documents it, so the options mirror the other tiers by analogy: if it accepted a different set, the game would simply ignore the value.

crafting_potion.crafting_skill_duration.description: How long the crafting skill buff lasts. The mod's main setting: for that time all your points go to crafting skill and you can't spend points or drink a Mindwipe.
crafting_potion.enable_potion_cooldown.description: When the buff ends the player gets a debuff preventing another potion for a while. The brake that stops potions being chained non-stop.
crafting_potion.enable_cheat_weight.description: While the buff is active the player gets a weight bonus so they don't end up encumbered — resetting stats takes weight with it. The amount is set below.
crafting_potion.enable_manual_deactivation.description: The player can drop the buff whenever they like (radial menu with R) instead of waiting out the timer.
crafting_potion.crafting_skill_cooldown_duration.descrip: How long before another potion can be drunk. Only applies with "Potion cooldown" enabled.
crafting_potion.crafting_skill_cheat_weight.description: How much weight the player gets while the buff lasts. Only applies with "Bonus weight during the buff" enabled, and it overrides the weight multiplier below.
crafting_potion.enable_extend_buff_time.description: Lets players drink more potions while the buff is active, adding to the timer instead of wasting them.
crafting_potion.enable_combat_check.description: When the buff ends, stats are only restored if the player hasn't been in combat recently. Closes the hole of using the potion as a mid-fight health reset.
crafting_potion.combat_duration.description: How long counts as "was recently in combat". Combat means dealing or taking any amount of damage. Only applies with the combat check enabled.
crafting_potion.display_activation_message.description: Shows a notification at the top of the screen on drinking, saying how many points went into crafting skill.
crafting_potion.display_deactivation_message.description: Shows a notification when the buff ends, confirming your original stats came back and how many levels each ended up with.
crafting_potion.activation_message_display_time.descript: How long the activation notification stays on screen. Only applies if that notice is on. The author clamps it between 1 and 10.
crafting_potion.deactivation_message_display_time.descri: How long the buff-expired notification stays on screen. Only applies if that notice is on. The author clamps it between 1 and 10.
crafting_potion.enable_restore_health.description: When the buff ends, health returns to what it was before the potion. Without this, resetting stats can leave you with less health than you had.
crafting_potion.enable_restore_stamina.description: When the buff ends, stamina returns to what it was before the potion.
crafting_potion.enable_restore_oxygen.description: When the buff ends, oxygen returns to what it was before the potion.
crafting_potion.enable_restore_food.description: When the buff ends, food returns to what it was before the potion.
crafting_potion.enable_restore_water.description: When the buff ends, water returns to what it was before the potion.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_health: Base health multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_health.description: While the buff lasts stats reset to ARK's base values. This scales base health: 1 = 100 health, 2 = 200.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_stamina: Base stamina multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_stamina.description: Scales base stamina while the buff lasts: 1 = 100 stamina, 2 = 200.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_oxygen: Base oxygen multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_oxygen.description: Scales base oxygen while the buff lasts: 1 = 100 oxygen, 2 = 200.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_food: Base food multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_food.description: Scales base food while the buff lasts: 1 = 100 food, 2 = 200.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_water: Base water multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_water.description: Scales base water while the buff lasts: 1 = 100 water, 2 = 200.
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_weight: Base weight multiplier during the buff
crafting_potion.base_stat_multiplier_weight.description: Scales base weight while the buff lasts: 1 = 100 weight, 2 = 200. If "Bonus weight during the buff" is on, that setting overrides this one.

death_recovery.delay_timer.description: How long before the gravestone can be used again. The default 30s only exists to prevent spam. Reference: 300 = 5 min, 1800 = 30 min, 3600 = 1 hour, 86400 = 1 day. If "Destroy the gravestone after use" is on, this becomes how long it takes to be destroyed.
death_recovery.use_once.description: The gravestone is destroyed after recovering items once, so a new one must be crafted for the next death. The most common way to keep dying from being consequence-free.
death_recovery.there_can_only_be_one.description: Prevents a player from placing more than one gravestone. Does not affect stones already placed.
death_recovery.decay_multiplier.description: Scales how long the gravestone takes to decay. At 1 (default) it lasts about 7 real days; 0.142857 makes it decay in 1 day and 0.428571 in 3. The author does not recommend going below 3 days.
death_recovery.disable_decay.description: The gravestone stops taking damage over time and needs no maintenance. Overrides the decay multiplier.
death_recovery.disable_pickup.description: Removes the pick-up option once placed. By default it already can't be picked up while the timer is running or while it is damaged.
death_recovery.use_global_timer.description: Every gravestone on the server shares a single cooldown: if one player uses theirs, everyone else has to wait. A hard brake that hits all players equally.
death_recovery.max_life_span.description: Seconds a gravestone can exist before destroying itself, regardless of decay. 0 means no limit. The quick way to clear old gravestones off a server.

dino_tracker.disable_wild_tracking.description: Turns off wild dino search, which only ever reaches dinos within render range anyway. The first thing to remove on servers where finding the creature is part of the game.
dino_tracker.disable_tribemember_tracking.description: Turns off the pointer to tribemates. By default it finds them even while offline, which in PvP gives away where the base is.
dino_tracker.disable_ally_tracking.description: Turns off tracking of allied tribe players. Useful when alliances on your server are ones of convenience and shouldn't double as a shared radar.
dino_tracker.disable_death_tracking.description: Removes the marker pointing at where you died. Without it, corpse recovery stops being automatic.
dino_tracker.disable_wild_find_button.description: Removes the button from the UI without touching the rest of the tracker. Handy to keep the UI clean once wild tracking is already off.
dino_tracker.disable_wild_coordinates.description: The tracker still points at the wild dino but stops showing its exact coordinates. A middle ground between full info and disabling tracking outright.

egg_n_poop.max_poop_stacks.description: How many stacks of poop the collector gathers before stopping; each stack holds up to 20. Set to -1 to stop collecting poop entirely and leave the mod for eggs only.
egg_n_poop.collect_interval.description: How often the collector runs. Lowering it makes it more responsive but it is the biggest performance cost of the mod, which is why the author clamps it between 25 and 45.
egg_n_poop.incubate_boost_multiplier.description: How much faster eggs inside the incubator's radius hatch. At 1 they run at normal ARK speed; the mod ships 1.5. It stacks with the server's hatch multiplier, so watch out for combining the two.
egg_n_poop.incubate_distance.description: Range within which the incubator speeds up and keeps fertilised eggs healthy. 1500 is roughly 5 foundations. Set to -1 to disable incubation. Eggs inside this radius are not picked up by the collector.
egg_n_poop.collect_distance.description: How far the collector reaches for eggs and poop. 20000 is roughly 75 foundations in every direction. Must be larger than the incubator radius. Raising it a lot on a big base is the quick route to performance problems.
egg_n_poop.silo_distance.description: Range within which the silo feeds poop and thatch to nearby compost bins and collects the finished fertilizer. Should be lower than or equal to the collector radius.
egg_n_poop.max_acha_poop_stacks.description: Counted separately from regular poop because Achatina organic polymer is a valuable resource. At 0 or -1 none is collected; the author recommends 10 to 15 if you want to automate cement production.
egg_n_poop.block_auto_compost_bins.description: Stops nearby compost bins from being filled automatically. Worth knowing: while this is off, compost bins get filled regardless of the poop stack limit set above.

glass_metal.glass_metal_r.description: Red channel (0 to 1) of the structures' default glass colour. Only takes effect if the mod is first in the server's load order.
glass_metal.glass_metal_g.description: Green channel (0 to 1) of the default glass colour. Only takes effect if the mod is first in the server's load order.
glass_metal.glass_metal_b.description: Blue channel (0 to 1) of the default glass colour. Only takes effect if the mod is first in the server's load order.

pet_finder.bed_prevent_range.description: The finder ignores dinos within this distance of one of your tribe's beds, so it doesn't flag every dino at your base. 10000 is roughly 50 foundations. Lowering it lets you find dinos closer to home. The author advises leaving it alone unless you know what you're doing.

pf_extinction.disable_vanilla_extinction_dinos.descrip: Takes Extinction's normal creatures out of the spawn pool so only the Primal Fear versions appear. What you turn on when you want the map to feel entirely like the expansion.
pf_extinction.disable_vanilla_corrupted_dinos.descript: Takes the base game's corrupted creatures out of the spawn pool, leaving only the expansion's (which already come in Fabled form).
pf_extinction.disable_vanilla_titans.description: Removes the base game's Titans. Note Titans are Extinction's endgame content, so this meaningfully changes what the map builds towards.

tombstone.keep_inventory_on_death.description: On respawn, the inventory stored in the tombstone is handed back automatically. Turning it off leaves the tombstone as a chest you have to walk to, which is the middle ground between this mod and vanilla.
tombstone.one_tombstone_per_player.description: Only each player's most recent tombstone survives; earlier ones are destroyed automatically. The brake on tombstone spam on servers where people die often.
tombstone.destroy_gravestone_when_empty.descriptio: The tombstone vanishes once you take everything out of it. It is not destroyed if you died carrying nothing. Keeps the map from filling up with empty tombstones.
tombstone.auto_destroy_after_seconds.description: At 0 (the default) the tombstone stays forever. Any higher value destroys it after that time: 345600 is 4 real days (4×60×60×24), 86400 is one day.
