add_equipment_durability.description: Repairs or refills equipment and hotbar items.

give_item_blueprint.label: Give item (weapons, saddles & more)
give_item_blueprint.description: Gives any item in the game: start typing its name (crossbow, saddle, kibble…) and pick it from the autocomplete — over 800 items across weapons, armor, saddles, consumables, eggs, dyes, artifacts and resources. Also accepts a hand-written blueprint path relative to /Game/.

server_chat.label: Server message
server_chat.description: Sends a chat message to every player.

server_chat_to.label: Private message by ID
server_chat_to.description: Sends a private message to the specified player ID.

server_chat_to_player.label: Private message by name
server_chat_to_player.description: Sends a private message to the specified player.

get_game_log.label: Read game log
get_game_log.description: Gets the game log for troubleshooting.

clear_player_inventory.label: Clear player inventory
clear_player_inventory.description: Removes a player's inventory, slots, and/or equipment.

allow_player_join.label: Allow player (whitelist)
allow_player_join.description: Lets an ID join without the usual restrictions.

set_admin_icon.label: Show admin icon
set_admin_icon.description: Toggles the administrator icon in chat.

set_cheat_player.label: Show cheat information
set_cheat_player.description: Toggles cheat debugging information on screen.

do_exit.label: Save and close server
do_exit.description: Saves and requests the server to shut down.

restart_level.label: Restart map
restart_level.description: Restarts the current level or map.

destroy_all_tames.label: Destroy all tames
destroy_all_tames.description: Deletes every tamed creature on the map.

destroy_actors.label: Destroy actors by class
destroy_actors.description: Deletes actors matching a class name.

destroy_wild_dino_classes.label: Destroy wild dinos by class
destroy_wild_dino_classes.description: Deletes wild creatures of the specified class.

destroy_structures.label: Destroy all structures
destroy_structures.description: Deletes structures owned by every player.

defeat_boss.label: Defeat boss
defeat_boss.description: Marks a boss as defeated for the specified player.

take_tribe.label: Take tribe ownership
take_tribe.description: Transfers a tribe's dinos and structures to the administrator.

destroy_tribe_id_dinos.label: Destroy tribe dinos
destroy_tribe_id_dinos.description: Deletes every tame owned by a tribe ID.

destroy_tribe_id_players.label: Destroy tribe players
destroy_tribe_id_players.description: Deletes the player characters of a tribe ID.

destroy_tribe_id_structures.label: Destroy tribe structures
destroy_tribe_id_structures.description: Deletes the structures of a tribe ID.

destroy_tribe_players.label: Destroy targeted tribe players
destroy_tribe_players.description: Deletes characters from the target's tribe.

params.armor_tier: Armor tier (Cloth, Hide, Chitin, Flak, Riot, Tek)
params.weapon_tier: Weapon tier (Primitive, Ramshackle, Apprentice, Journeyman, Mastercraft, Ascendant)

gmsummon.label: Spawn tamed dino
gmsummon.description: Spawns an already-tamed dino next to you, at the exact level you choose. The most popular for testing or setting up servers. Also works with mod dinos — type the full className manually if it's not in the dropdown.

force_tame.label: Tame target
force_tame.description: Instantly tames the dino you're aiming at. If already tamed by another player, transfers ownership to you.

set_baby_age.label: Set baby age
set_baby_age.description: Changes the age of the baby you're aiming at. 0.0 = newborn, 1.0 = adult. Useful for testing breeding without waiting.

destroy_wild_dinos.label: Destroy all wild dinos
destroy_wild_dinos.description: Removes all wild dinos from the map. New ones will respawn normally. Useful for cleaning the map before changing configs.

destroy_all.label: Destroy all instances of a species
destroy_all.description: Deletes all creatures (wild and tamed) of the indicated species. Useful for cleaning saturated maps or removing dinos from a mod you uninstalled.

enemy_invisible.label: Invisible to enemies
enemy_invisible.description: Toggles wild dinos ignoring you. Useful for exploring dangerous areas without combat.

summon.label: Spawn wild dino
summon.description: Spawns a wild (untamed) dino at your position. Use `Summon Rex_Character_BP_C` and the like. For modded dinos write the full className.

summon_tamed.label: Spawn tamed dino at your feet
summon_tamed.description: Like GMSummon but levelless — appears tamed instantly next to you with vanilla base-level stats.

do_tame.label: Tame instantly
do_tame.description: Instantly tames the creature under your crosshair. Faster shortcut than ForceTame in some cases.

force_tame_aoe.label: Tame everything in radius
force_tame_aoe.description: Tames every wild dino within the given radius. Beware! Can affect hundreds of dinos. Default 1000 units.

set_baby_age_aoe.label: Set baby age in radius
set_baby_age_aoe.description: Changes the age of ALL babies within the given radius. Useful to speed up multiple babies at once.

set_imprint_quality.label: Set imprint quality
set_imprint_quality.description: Changes the imprint quality of the targeted baby. 1.0 = perfect 100% imprint without waiting for cuddles.

add_mutations.label: Add mutations
add_mutations.description: ASA only. Adds mutations to the selected stat on the targeted dino. Stats range from 0 to 7; use it to test breeding lines.

set_target_dino_color.label: Change targeted dino's color
set_target_dino_color.description: Changes the color of one region (0-5) of the dino you're aiming at. ColorID lookup on ARK Wiki.

change_size.label: Change dino size
change_size.description: Changes the size of the targeted dino. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double, 0.5 = half. Useful for cinematic shots.

clear_cryo_sickness.label: Clear cryo sickness
clear_cryo_sickness.description: Removes the cryo-sickness debuff from the targeted dino (no need to wait 5 minutes).

cryo_my_target.label: Instant cryopod
cryo_my_target.description: Cryos the targeted dino without needing a cryopod item. Useful for fast moving/transferring.

force_poop.label: Force poop
force_poop.description: Makes the targeted dino poop instantly. Useful for fertilizer or testing.

give_colors.label: Give all colors
give_colors.description: Grants the full color mutation palette to your breeding inventory.

hatch_egg.label: Hatch egg
hatch_egg.description: Instantly hatches the egg you're aiming at. Works with fertilized eggs in any state.

level_up_target.label: Level up targeted dino
level_up_target.description: Adds N levels to a stat (Health, Stamina, etc.) on the targeted dino. Stats: Health, Stamina, Torpidity, Oxygen, Food, Water, Temperature, Weight, MeleeDamageMultiplier, MovementSpeedMultiplier.

gfi.label: Give item by keyword (GFI)
gfi.description: Gives any item searching by a keyword (e.g. 'wood' = wood, 'sword' = sword). The easiest method — you don't need to know the full class name.

give_resource.label: Give resource
give_resource.description: Gives a quantity of a resource (metal, wood, pearls, gems…): start typing its name and pick it from the autocomplete — 83 resources with their blueprint path verified. More precise than GFI, which matches by text and can silently give another item.

give_resources_bundle.label: Give resource bundle
give_resources_bundle.description: Gives 50 of every basic resource (wood, stone, metal, etc.) in one go.

give_xp.label: Give experience
give_xp.description: Adds XP points to your character (or to the dino you're riding if mounted).

give_item_num.label: Give item by numeric ID
give_item_num.description: Gives an item using its internal numeric ID (older than GFI). Useful for legacy script commands or when you already know the ID.

give_item_num_to_player.label: Give item to another player (by numeric ID)
give_item_num_to_player.description: Gives an item to another player (Player ID, not Steam ID). Useful for handing out loot in server events.

give_armor_set.label: Give full armor set
give_armor_set.description: Gives a full armor set of the indicated tier (Cloth, Hide, Chitin, Flak, Riot, Tek). Quality ascending and forceBlueprint=1 = blueprint.

give_weapon_set.label: Give full weapon set
give_weapon_set.description: Gives the weapon set of the indicated tier (Primitive, Ramshackle, Apprentice, Journeyman, Mastercraft, Ascendant).

add_hexagons.label: Add hexagons (Genesis)
add_hexagons.description: Adds N hexagons to your inventory (Genesis 1/2 currency). Only applies on Genesis maps.

set_time_of_day.label: Set time of day
set_time_of_day.description: Sets the in-game time in 24h format. For example `12:00` = noon, `00:00` = midnight.

slomo.label: Change game speed
slomo.description: Modifies simulation speed. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = half speed, 5.0 = five times faster.

save_world.label: Force save
save_world.description: Saves the world state immediately, without waiting for autosave. Useful before closing the server or experimenting.

broadcast.label: On-screen message to all
broadcast.description: Sends a message to the top of every connected player's screen. Ideal for quick announcements or community events.

set_message_of_the_day.label: Set message of the day (MOTD)
set_message_of_the_day.description: Changes the message of the day shown when joining the server. Persistent until set again.

tp_coords.label: Teleport by GPS coords
tp_coords.description: Teleports you to Lat/Lon coords (ARK GPS format). For example `TPCoords 50 50 0` = map center at sea level.

set_player_pos.label: Teleport by UE coords
set_player_pos.description: Teleports you to absolute Unreal coords (X/Y/Z, not GPS). Useful when you have exact coords from wiki/community.

ce_weather.label: Force weather event
ce_weather.description: Activates or stops a weather event (Rain, Fog, Heatwave, Storm, etc.). Behavior varies by map.

players_only.label: Pause everything except players
players_only.description: Freezes the world (dinos don't move, decay doesn't progress) but players stay active. Crafting is instant.

destroy_my_target.label: Destroy target (no loot)
destroy_my_target.description: Removes the structure/creature you're aiming at, without generating a corpse or loot bag.

destroy_all_enemies.label: Destroy all hostiles
destroy_all_enemies.description: Removes ALL hostile dinos from the map (doesn't touch your tames). New ones respawn normally.

destroy_foliage.label: Destroy nearby foliage
destroy_foliage.description: Removes nearby trees, bushes and rocks. Useful for clean shots or clearing a build site.

open_map.label: Switch map
open_map.description: Switches/reloads the current map. E.g. `open Aberration_P`, `open TheIsland`, `open Ragnarok`. On a server, restarts with the new map.

god.label: God mode
god.description: Toggles total immunity. You take no damage from dinos, players or environment (cold, heat, hunger, etc.).

fly.label: Enable flight
fly.description: Activates fly mode. You move freely through the air using WASD + space/shift.

walk.label: Disable flight
walk.description: Returns to normal walk mode. Use after `fly` or `ghost`.

ghost.label: Ghost mode (noclip)
ghost.description: Activates ghost mode. You fly through any structure, terrain or dino. Combine with `fly` for max freedom.

infinite_stats.label: Infinite stats
infinite_stats.description: Fills all stats (health, food, water, oxygen, stamina) to max and keeps them while active.

teleport.label: Teleport forward
teleport.description: Teleports you in the direction you're looking. Useful to escape fights or explore quickly.

toggle_infinite_ammo.label: Infinite ammo
toggle_infinite_ammo.description: Toggles infinite ammo. No bullets consumed while active.

hurt_me.label: Take damage (testing)
hurt_me.description: Applies the indicated damage to yourself. Useful to test armor, food or health effects without dying.

make_tribe_admin.label: Promote to tribe admin
make_tribe_admin.description: Promotes you to admin of your own tribe. Useful when you lost the role or need permissions in single-player.

kick_player.label: Kick player
kick_player.description: Kicks the player with the given Steam ID from the server. Only works in multiplayer with cheats enabled.

give_engrams.label: Unlock all engrams
give_engrams.description: Gives you all engrams in the game including Tek. Useful for fast testing or for creators.

give_creative_mode.label: Enable creative mode
give_creative_mode.description: Enables creative mode on your character: flight + invincibility + free crafting.

give_creative_mode_to_player.label: Creative mode to another player
give_creative_mode_to_player.description: Enables creative mode on the player with the given ID. To grant admin powers.

level_up.label: Level up your character
level_up.description: Adds N levels of one of your stats (Health, Stamina, etc.). If you're mounted, levels up the dino.

refill_stats.label: Refill stats to max
refill_stats.description: Fills all your stats to max (health, stamina, food, water, oxygen). One-shot.

clear_my_buffs.label: Clear all buffs/debuffs
clear_my_buffs.description: Clears all your active buffs and debuffs (radiation, bleed, freeze, etc.).

suicide.label: Suicide
suicide.description: Kills your character instantly to force respawn. Faster than waiting for a real death.

rename_player.label: Rename player
rename_player.description: Renames the player character with the indicated current name.

give_all_explorer_notes.label: Unlock all explorer notes
give_all_explorer_notes.description: Gives you all the Explorer Notes in the game in one go.

max_ascend.label: Max ascension
max_ascend.description: Levels your character up to the max ascension (Alpha on every boss) without fighting.

ban_player.label: Ban player (permanent)
ban_player.description: Permanently bans the player with the given Steam ID. To revert use UnbanPlayer.

unban_player.label: Unban player
unban_player.description: Lifts the ban on the player with the given Steam ID.

teleport_to_player.label: Teleport to a player
teleport_to_player.description: Teleports you to another player's location (use their Player ID, not Steam ID). To find Player ID run ListPlayers.

rename_tribe.label: Rename tribe
rename_tribe.description: Changes the tribe name (looked up by current name). Quotes around the first arg are required.

take_all_dino.label: Take all dinos from target tribe
take_all_dino.description: Transfers every dino from the targeted player/dino's tribe to your tribe.

take_all_structure.label: Take all structures from target tribe
take_all_structure.description: Transfers every structure from the targeted player/structure's tribe to your tribe.

force_player_to_join_tribe.label: Force player to join your tribe
force_player_to_join_tribe.description: Forces the player with the indicated Player ID into your tribe, no invite. Useful for coordinated events.

get_tribe_id_player_list.label: List members of a tribe
get_tribe_id_player_list.description: Prints the members (Player ID + name) of the tribe with the given ID.

destroy_tribe_dinos.label: Destroy target tribe's dinos
destroy_tribe_dinos.description: Removes every dino from the targeted player/dino's tribe. Irreversible.

destroy_tribe_structures.label: Destroy target tribe's structures
destroy_tribe_structures.description: Removes every structure from the targeted player/structure's tribe. Irreversible.

destroy_tribe_id.label: Destroy tribe by ID (everything)
destroy_tribe_id.description: Wipes everything (dinos + structures + dropped items) from the tribe with the given ID. Irreversible.

list_players.label: List connected players
list_players.description: Prints every online player with their Player ID and Steam ID. Essential before commands by player ID.

dump_dino_stats.label: Dump targeted dino's stats
dump_dino_stats.description: Prints the full stats of the dino you're aiming at (each stat's level, imprint bonus, mutations, etc.).

tribe_structure_audit.label: Tribe structure inventory
tribe_structure_audit.description: Lists all structures of the indicated tribe with their types and positions.

tribe_dino_audit.label: Tribe dino inventory
tribe_dino_audit.description: Lists all dinos of the indicated tribe with their stats and positions.

save_backup.label: Create backup (single-player)
save_backup.description: Creates a manual save backup (ASA-only, added in patch 66.0). Useful before experimenting.

show_my_admin_manager.label: Open admin panel (UI)
show_my_admin_manager.description: Opens the graphical administration panel. Provides menu access to kick, ban, and promote players.

copy_coords_to_clipboard.label: Copy current coords
copy_coords_to_clipboard.description: Copies your current coordinates (X/Y/Z) to clipboard. The actual command is `ccc`. Essential for guides and videos.

stat_fps.label: Show FPS on screen
stat_fps.description: Shows current FPS in the corner. Useful for performance debugging.

stat_unit.label: Show performance profile
stat_unit.description: Shows detailed perf info: ms per frame, GPU/CPU/GameThread, draw calls. For optimizing.

rain_dinos.label: Rain of dinos (epic)
rain_dinos.description: Drops dinos from the sky at your position. Spectacular for shots, watch your camera.

rain_critters.label: Rain of small critters
rain_critters.description: Like RainDinos but with small creatures (dodos, lystrosaurus, etc.). More controllable for scenes.

rain_danger.label: Rain of dangerous creatures
rain_danger.description: Drops strong hostile creatures (Rex, Giga, Therizino). For action shots.

enable_spectator.label: Spectator mode (aerial shots)
enable_spectator.description: Turns you into a flying spectator with free camera, no collision and no damage. Essential for creators. On ASE you must die first.

stop_spectating.label: Exit spectator mode
stop_spectating.description: Returns to your character from spectator mode.

toggle_gun.label: Hide/show equipped weapon
toggle_gun.description: Hides your character's weapon without unequipping it. Essential for clean shots without the weapon on screen.

custom_classnames.dialog_description: Add classnames from your mods so they show up in the autocomplete of commands and spawn/resource/dino/engram settings. They're saved in your preferences and persist across sessions.
custom_classnames.empty: No classnames yet. Use the form below to add the ones from your mods.

engrams.search_placeholder: Search engram by name or classname…
engrams.empty: The engram catalog is empty. Add yours in "My classnames" → Engrams tab.

maps.the_island.description: ARK's base map. Varied biomes (jungle, mountain, snow, swamp), original Explorer Notes, and all base bosses. Works great for tutorials and generic servers.
maps.the_center.description: Official free map with a central paradise-like floating biome and varied outer biomes. Almost full base fauna. Good community-server map.
maps.scorched_earth.description: Paid DLC desert: sandstorms, extreme heat, exclusive creatures (Wyverns, Mantis, Rock Elementals). More hardcore from spawn.
maps.ragnarok.description: VERY popular free map: blends Island + Scorched biomes. Features Wyverns, Griffins and an active volcano. Favorite of many PvE servers.
maps.aberration.description: Paid DLC: underground map with radiation, no flying allowed. Unique creatures: Reapers, Rock Drakes, Karkinos. Exclusive Hazmat and Charge Battery engrams.
maps.extinction.description: Paid DLC: futuristic post-apocalyptic earth with Titans (King/Forest/Desert/Ice), Element Veins and global cooldown mechanics. Tek-heavy endgame.
maps.valguero.description: Official free map with Aberration sections and varied biomes (jungle, fjord, white cliffs). Good for community servers without paid DLC.
maps.genesis_part1.description: Paid DLC Season Pass 2: simulation with biome-specific missions (lunar, arctic, oceanic, lava, bog), hexagons as currency, exclusive dinos like Magmasaur/Astrocetus.
maps.crystal_isles.description: Free map with magical crystals and fantasy biomes. Exclusive Crystal Wyverns, dragons, ethereal biomes. Visually distinct from the rest.
maps.genesis_part2.description: Paid DLC Season Pass 2: colonial spaceship with Eden/Rockwell biomes, Tek Stryders, Maewing, Noglin, Astrodelphis. End of ASE's canonical lore.
maps.lost_island.description: Free map with new creatures: Sinomacrops, Amargasaurus, Dinopithecus. Tropical and volcanic biomes. Released 2021.
maps.fjordur.description: Free Norse-mythology map with 4 realms (Vannahem, Bolbjord, Vardiland, Asgard). Exclusive creatures: Fjordhawk, Andrewsarchus, Desmodus, Fenrir.
maps.astraeos.description: Official free map for ASA (2025). Community-designed and promoted by Wildcard. Varied biomes with PvE focus.

tips.label: Tip
tips.duplicate_for_testing: Duplicate a profile before experimenting — that way you have an intact backup.
tips.expert_mode: Expert mode unlocks all ARK settings, including the most obscure ones.
tips.import_preserves: When importing a .ini, keys the catalog doesn't know about are preserved — you lose nothing.
tips.dedicated_bat: The Dedicated Server profile also generates a start_server.bat with launch parameters.
tips.summary_panel: The summary panel shows the real effect of your changes in plain language.
tips.game_ini_and_gus: ARK uses two files: Game.ini for gameplay and GameUserSettings.ini for server options.
tips.settings_filter: Basic mode hides advanced settings to simplify the interface.
tips.no_default_no_export: Values at their default are not exported — the resulting .ini only includes what you changed.

preferences.dialog_description: Language, theme, visibility mode and other general preferences.
preferences.visibility_hint: Basic hides advanced settings. Expert shows them all.
preferences.submitter_hint: Used when suggesting a mod from the app — so the GitHub issue is signed.
preferences.reset_hint: Restores language, theme, mode and prefix to defaults. Profiles and custom classnames are not touched.
preferences.reset_confirm_message: This restores language, theme, visibility mode, console prefix and submitter name to their defaults. Your profiles, mods and custom classnames are not touched.

hardware.title: Detect my PC
hardware.subtitle: Graphics recommendation based on your hardware.
hardware.idle_hint: We will read your CPU, RAM, GPU and drives to recommend a graphics quality preset.
hardware.detection_failed: Could not detect hardware. Make sure the app is running inside Tauri (not in a web browser).
hardware.reason_vram_fallback: Estimated by available VRAM (model not recognized).
hardware.storage_penalty_note: We dropped one tier because only HDDs were detected — ARK's asset streaming can stutter. If you have an SSD that didn't show up, ignore this notice.

editor.import_unrecognized: {count} unknown keys (preserved for the next export)
editor.import_skipped: {count} settings skipped due to a type mismatch

preview.title: Config preview
preview.only_changes_hint: Only what you changed. This is what you paste at the end of an existing .ini, or share in a video or Discord.
preview.full_file_hint: Your changes plus everything preserved from the .ini you imported. This is the file ready to replace the server's one — do not paste it on top of an existing file or you will duplicate keys.
preview.empty: Nothing to write yet: you have not changed any setting or imported an .ini.
preview.full_file_no_import: This profile never imported an .ini, so there is nothing extra to preserve: the result is identical to "my changes only". A real GameUserSettings.ini has hundreds of keys the game writes itself. If you are going to replace the server file, import yours first.
preview.import_mods_found: {count} mods found in ActiveMods ({catalogued} with settings in the catalogue)

updater.description: You have {current} and {next} is available. Updating restarts the app; your configs are untouched.
